topic: building a sustainable morning routine while working from home

gold_fact.text: Every morning before work the user does a 20-minute mobility routine; it recurs across many sessions as a daily habit.

question: What does the user usually do each morning before work?

traps.description: A single session describes a one-off long hike, which superficially looks like exercise but is not the recurring morning routine.
Several scattered mentions of different one-time activities to dilute the recurring signal.

rationale: Answer requires aggregating repeated occurrences into a habit pattern; a single one-off mention is insufficient, and a w/e/o store has no repetition semantics.
